__NOEDITSECTION__
Actions are engine operations used by [[Eden Editor: Menu Bar|Menu Bar]] and are available for scripting.

Perform an action:
<sqf>do3DENAction "actionName"</sqf>

Get action state, can be 0 or 1. Available only for selected actions (see the '''State''' column below); when an action doesn't have any state, -1 is returned.
<sqf>get3DENActionState "actionName"</sqf>

Since {{GVI|arma3|2.22}} some actions can also have an argument. See syntax 2 of [[do3DENAction]].

|-
|
{{ArgTitle|4|CreateTextFile|{{GVI|arma3|2.22}}}}
|
Creates a text file in the scenario folder.
|
{{Icon|unchecked}}
|
[[HashMap]] with the following keys:
* name: [[String]] - name of the file. Maximum length 64 characters. Can only contain {{hl|A-z0-9_-}} characters. Name is force-prefixed with {{hl|generated_}}
* folder: [[String]] - (optional, default "") - name of the subfolder. Only one level is supported. Maximum allowed characters 16. Can only contain {{hl|A-z0-9_-}} characters
* content: [[String]] - content of the file
<sqf>
private _par = createHashMap;
_par set ["name", "testfile"];
_par set ["folder", "subfolder"];
_par set ["content", "R3voing"];

do3DENAction ["CreateTextFile", _par];
</sqf>

==== MoveGridDecrease ====
|
Decreases the move grid by 0.25 m. If this grid doesn't exist a new entry is added to the drop down menu in the toolbar (3.75 m (Custom)).
Also triggers {{hl|OnMoveGridDecrease}} event.
|
{{Icon|unchecked}}
|
|-
|
==== MoveGridIncrease ====
|
Increases the move grid by 0.25 m. If this grid doesn't exist a new entry is added to the drop down menu in the toolbar (3.75 m (Custom)).
Also triggers {{hl|OnMoveGridIncrease}} event.
|
{{Icon|unchecked}}
